spec_match.rationale: Attempts the exact proposed surface navigator.playHaptics('tick', 0.8) and reports its real typeof/return, beside the real navigator.vibrate([50,100,50]) with the actual boolean surfaced; the comparison table states the explainer's contrasts (intent vs milliseconds, no success signal, sticky activation, 'haptics' policy).

interactive.rationale: Both buttons execute real calls and write the live outcome into aria-live outputs; nothing is simulated.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises the canonical call beside the legacy API with real return values, which is exactly what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers API-absent (skip branch, flag + OS + hardware prerequisites named, never browser age alone), vibrate-absent (Safari note, button disabled with explanation), vibrate-false (activation), and the accepted-but-unfelt desktop gap.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5167864517623808, the WICG explainer's vibrate-alternatives section, and MDN vibrate.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite probes the exact IDL (exists/typeof/returns-undefined/closed-enum TypeError/NaN TypeError/arity/policy registration) plus a manual hardware assertion; verified executing on /conformance/ at 0 pass / 8 fail / 1 blocked on Chromium 141 — all honest fails pre-implementation.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright-driven headless Chromium 141 (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): both buttons clicked — playHaptics path reports the unsupported branch verbatim, vibrate executed returning true; zero console errors, zero failed requests; screenshots read at 1280×800 and emulated 360×740 DPR3 touch, horizontal overflow 0 on both.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts playhaptics-probe-ran on load, the explicit playhaptics-fallback-branch when absent, playhaptics-returns-undefined on a real call, and vibrate-returned-boolean; throw paths assert false so regressions surface in telemetry.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons set background and color together with a distinct disabled state; the shared .support.yes/.no high-contrast states from styles.css style the banner.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with explicit labels, role=status support banner, aria-live result outputs, semantic comparison table with scoped headers, focusable code blocks; tab order verified sensible in the browser.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The two lanes collapse to one column via auto-fit minmax; measured scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0 at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800; both screenshots read — legible, 44px buttons, no clipped controls.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the real-call branch on a WebHaptics-enabled Windows 11 24H2 build
openQuestions.detail: On this Chromium 141 the supported branch is honestly unreachable. On a Canary with --enable-blink-features=WebHaptics on Windows 11 24H2+, confirm playHaptics('tick', 0.8) returns undefined, the enum/NaN TypeError assertions flip to pass, and update this critique's evidence.

openQuestions.title: Track the effect vocabulary as the explainer stabilizes
openQuestions.detail: The Chromium IDL ships hint/edge/tick/align while the explainer also proposes success/error. If the shipped enum grows, the comparison table and the conformance closed-enum assertion's description (not the assertion logic, which only requires an unknown name to throw) should be reviewed by a human.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce live status updates to screen readers after a button action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Surface post-interaction results through live regions and keep result surfaces semantic.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both lanes write results into <output aria-live="polite"> elements and the support banner is role=status; the contrast table is a real table with scoped headers.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel layout without horizontal overflow on narrow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use wrapping grid/flex (auto-fit minmax) and avoid fixed-width panels so panels stack on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The duel uses grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 320px), 1fr)); verified 0 horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3.

summary: Canonical + migration concept: the proposed semantic call and the shipped pattern API side by side, each executed for real with its actual return value surfaced, and the unsupported branch stated with flag, OS floor, and hardware prerequisites rather than browser age.
